items.description:
In the deepest depths of the underground lurks a new and scary creature. Embrace the darkness of the deep caverns and become a warden with these themed skins!

items.title: Orc Invasion
items.creator: Glowfischdesigns
items.description:
Orcs are invading your castle! The villagers need you to save them from certain defeat!
Fight the orc army with all new weapons and tools. Show them who is the real king!

+ 19 orc variations!
+ Play with up to 4 friends!
+ New 3D weapons & traps!
+ Animated cutscenes & audio dialogs!
+ Epic boss fight!
+ Music!
+ New Upgrades!
+ New Towers!
+ New Weapons!

Get in your city and be cool! Have fun with the city's favorite trendy skins. Go ahead and start playing!

items.title: Incognito Teens
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
Goofy teens wore the incognito masks from techno museum and they are seeing the unseen. They have gone disguised to experience the hidden dimensions of the world.

- 21 masked skins
+ 1 free skin!
- By Pixelusion & Lostduckies!

items.title: Masked

Masked teens are out on the streets to experience the party life at most. Choose a mask to enter the party!

items.title: Troll Faces
items.creator: Pixelusion
items.description:
How much of a prankster are you? Put on one of these troll faces outfits and prank all of your friends in the rules of art!

- Ideal for trolling your friends!

items.title: Ninja Rooftop Adventure
items.creator: Giggle Block Studios
items.description:
Free your mind and delve into the deep mysteries of this ancient city! Ninja rooftop adventure is perfect for practicing parkour and battle skills! Don't forget that once you are complete you can easily turn the map into creative mode and enjoy the awesome builds as you expand your oasis further!
* Multiplayer fun!
* Bosses!
* Carefree parkour!
By Giggle Block Studios!

items.title: Billionaires Mansion
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Become a billionaire and impress your friends with Billionaires Mansion. Take endless vacations and make a nice day in your mansion´s pool. Cruise the jetskis to your own yacht or take your new helicopter for a ride. Invite your friends to a party and pick them up in your luxury car.

- 2 jetskis
- Custom car & helicopter 
- Mansion 
- Yacht

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Luxury Hotel
items.creator: Mine-North
items.description:
Start your holiday trip to the Luxury Hotel. Play with your friends and start your roleplay. Fly with a helicopter or drive with a boat or the cars and explore the world.

+ Holiday hotel
+ Helicopter
+ Car
+ Luxury car with colour changes
+ Boat
+ 3 skins

Created by Mine-North

items.title: Millionaire Monarchs
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Consider yourself royalty with this epic skin pack! Become a wealthy King, Queen, or Knight! Show off your money with the bling in your outfit!

+ 12 custom skins for you to choose from!
+ Unique and rich royalty outfits!

items.title: Colorful Animal Onesies
items.creator: Impulse
items.description:
Be a colorful blue leopard, red shark, or pink zebra! Show off your love of color and animals while staying cute and trendy!

+ 12 custom skins for you to choose from!
+ Unique animal onesie skins!

items.title: Sharks!
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Some cool fins washed up to shore this season and they are ready for some extreme fun under the sun! Gamers, wizards, queens, mobsters, athletes. 14 shark skins to choose from! Show those summer teeth and get to chompin on your next adventure.

items.title: Knight Arcade
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Laser sabers, electric armor, neon lights, arcade kingdoms. 15 colorful knight skins hailing from both retro past and sci-fi future, designed to amp up your game.

items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Come test your fighting skills and find your path to victory.

- 8 dungeons
- 2 bosses
- 11 orc variants
- 5 skeleton variants...

...and even more rare creatures lurking in the darkness.

items.title: Old Suits
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
These suits are old, but they will never go out of style! Put them on and be the center of attention at any party.

- Twelve Old Suits.
- One skin totally free.
- By DragonClub Studios.

items.title: Wizardry High School
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
You are in a wizarding high school and each classroom has students with gifts and abilities worthy of being the best in high school. If you want to be recognized and not be left behind, you've come to the right place! Being the best in high school will be easy!

-Twelve skins, including 6 men and 6 women
-1 skin free
-Created by DragonClub Studios

items.title: Fashion Lifestyle
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
What's better than wearing the coolest outfit? Join the most popular teens in the city! Wear the latest designer clothes and stun with your friends. Don't miss the latest drop of swag and style. Show off your passion for fashion!

- Perfect for multiplayer
